scoringPolicy.requiredProbe: predicate and stance match, and the anchored source span covers the candidate quote span
scoringPolicy.forbiddenProbe: exact predicate and stance pair appears in the extraction
scoringPolicy.caseAssertionProbePass: valid non-empty extraction with no quarantine, no missing required probes, and no forbidden probe matches
scoringPolicy.denominator: all 40 cases, including missing outputs and provider/extractor failures
scoringPolicy.gapScoring: not evaluated because the extraction output contract contains no gaps field
limitations: Candidate expectations are not expert-approved gold and cover selected probes, not the full semantic graph.
Cases are synthetic, clustered in eight contrast families, and include zero verified real incidents.
The assertion-probe rate is not the 80% critical-error-free target and is not a population accuracy estimate.
Legal sufficiency, event truth, disposition, and expected-gap detection are not scored.
